response.sql: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS average_pulse_rate FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), first_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(average_pulse_rate) AS value FROM telescope_averages), first_pass AS (SELECT t.average_pulse_rate FROM telescope_averages AS t CROSS JOIN first_baseline AS b WHERE t.average_pulse_rate > b.value), second_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(average_pulse_rate) AS value FROM first_pass) SELECT AVG(p.average_pulse_rate) AS mean_average_pulse_rate, AVG(p.average_pulse_rate - b1.value) AS mean_excess_over_first_baseline, AVG(p.average_pulse_rate - b2.value) AS mean_excess_over_second_baseline FROM first_pass AS p CROSS JOIN first_baseline AS b1 CROSS JOIN second_baseline AS b2 WHERE p.average_pulse_rate > b2.value;
